Expense Reimbursement Procedure

Employees are reimbursed for reasonable business expenses incurred while working on company matters.

Submitting Claims

Receipts must be submitted through the SpendTrack portal within 30 days of the expense. Claims older than 30 days are rejected unless a manager grants an exception.

Limits

  • Meals are reimbursed up to $75 per day while travelling.
  • Personal car use is reimbursed at a mileage rate of $0.67 per mile.
  • Hotel stays above $250 per night require pre-approval.

Payment

Approved claims are paid with the next monthly payroll run.

Finance Operations, internal use only
